description:
Welcome to Mavian Beauty, where luxury and affordability meet to create an exceptional spa-like facial experience at home. Developed by a master esthetician, our premium line of skincare tools and accessories are designed in America and combine the most advanced plasma technologies from Japan and Korea for at-home skin care like no other. 

With a strong focus on quality and real skincare concerns, we provide all the essentials and step-by-step instructions for an effortless yet effective routine. Indulge in the Mavian Beauty experience and transform your daily routine into a lavish ritual that will leave you feeling pampered, refreshed, and loved the way you and your skin deserve.

• Product description:
- Makeup Remover Pads: remove makeup and face masks with just water.
- Profound Sonic Brush: Clean & Exfoliate in your daily skincare routine. Removes all dirt, oil, and makeup residue, and massages your face for maximum skincare absorption.
- Led Light Derma Roller: Alternative for micro-needling in the comfort of your own home. The Led light helps eliminate dark spots, hyperpigmentation, wrinkles, and scars on your face and body.
- Beautifying Serums: Age Renewal with Retinol, Hydration Boost with Hyaluronic Acid and C'Serum to brighten up dark spots. 
- Professional Nano Facial Steamer: Powerful as the commercial steammers, the hot steam will open the pores to promote deep cleansing and stimulate blood circulation, while the cold steam will refine pores calms the skin.
- Acne Care Plasma: Latest beauty technology from Korea to treat acne, countour the face, and promote skincare absorption. 
- Hydro Deep Cleansing Device: Gently exfoliates dead skin cells and impurities with the help of our Mavian Exfoliating Serum.
- 4 in 1 Anti-Aging Facelift Device: This device has all key functions to maintain healthy and firm skin, and improve sagging skin.
- Total Glow Face Mask - Contains 13.5% pure vitamin C cream. Fully infused with 10 layered HA (Hyaluronic Acid) for comprehensive skincare. Has an anti-wrinkle ingredient that boost collagen and elastin production.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):
Skincare tools and products to help people take care of their own skin at home, offering tools and knowledge to use them with confidence.
 
• Payment terms: 10% commission will be paid every 15 days (minimum amount to receive $25)

• Other information:
Mavian's mission is simple: to help people feel confident and beautiful in their own skin.
